Archer Kumkum Mohod Targets Olympics and Meeting Virat Kohli

Archer Kumkum Mohod, based in Amravati, Maharashtra, is aiming for a gold medal at the Los Angeles Olympics. She is also a fan of cricketer Virat Kohli, whom she hopes to meet, citing his discipline and hard work as inspirations.
